text: Engineering mechanics is an interdisciplinary subject that is based on theoretical mechanics and material mechanics, and combines mathematics, physics and engineering applications to study the mechanical motion and force analysis of objects. It is not only the theoretical foundation of engineering science but also the core tool for solving practical engineering problems. It covers mechanical analysis from macroscopic structures (such as Bridges and buildings) to microscopic materials (such as nanocomponents), aiming to provide theoretical support for engineering design, manufacturing and optimization.
